/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/server/repositories/attachment-repository.ts')
s=p.read_text(); marker='export async function insertAttachment('
s=s.replace(marker, '''export async function findAttachmentById(
  orgId: OrgId,
  attachmentId: AttachmentId,
): Promise<IssueAttachment | null> {
  const row = getDb()
    .select()
    .from(attachments)
    .where(and(orgPredicate(attachments.orgId, orgId), eq(attachments.id, attachmentId)))
    .get();
  return row ? toAttachment(row) : null;
}

'''+marker); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/attachment-service.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('await findAttachment(input.orgId, input.attachmentId)', 'await attachmentRepo.findAttachmentById(input.orgId, input.attachmentId)').replace('-Math.floor(attachment.sizeBytes / BYTES_PER_MB)', '-Math.ceil(attachment.sizeBytes / BYTES_PER_MB)'); s=s[:s.index('/**\\n * The attachment repository only reads by issue')]; s=s.replace(' * Removing an attachment gives the megabytes back to the quota — only whole\\n * ones, so a removal can never push the counter below what is really stored.', ' * Removing an attachment returns the same rounded amount charged on upload.'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('const bytes = db\\n    .select({ value: sql<number | null>"'`sum(${attachments.sizeBytes})` })'"\\n    .from(attachments)\\n    .get();', 'const storage = db\\n    .select({ value: sql<number | null>"'`sum((${attachments.sizeBytes} + ${BYTES_PER_MB} - 1) / ${BYTES_PER_MB})` })'"\\n    .from(attachments)\\n    .where(eq(attachments.orgId, orgId))\\n    .get();').replace('Math.ceil((bytes?.value ?? 0) / BYTES_PER_MB)', 'storage?.value ?? 0'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/billing-service.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('import * as attachmentRepo from \"@/server/repositories/attachment-repository\";\\n','').replace('const BYTES_PER_MB = 1024 * 1024;\\n\\n','').replace(' * Maps a quota dimension onto the counter that measures it. Storage is read\\n * from the attachment table itself: the cached counter only moves on the\\n * upload path, so it would lag behind what is actually stored.', ' * Maps each quota dimension onto the counter that measures it.').replace('return Math.round(\\n        (await attachmentRepo.sumStorageBytes(orgId)) / BYTES_PER_MB,\\n      );','return usage.storageMbUsed;'); p.write_text(s)
